$comment: Every rule from repositories we borrow lint rules from, with our decision. Run `bun run rules:check` after an upstream change. Statuses: adopted (vendored, enabled as `as`), covered (another enabled rule does the job: `by`), candidate (looks good, not vendored yet), declined (`reason`). `hits` counts matches in this repo when the rule was reviewed.

dillon.author: Dillon Mulroy

kyle.author: Kyle Mistele
kyle.reachesUs: Fork of Dillon's. Adopted rules are copied verbatim into vendor/anti-slop/ and loaded as `anti-slop/*`.
notes: skills/effect-program-design conflicts with AGENTS.md: it requires tests and fakes only in test/ (we keep src/testing/ and in-memory adapters) and makes every capability a Context.Service (we add a port only when needed).

no-array-filter-map.reason: Cheap perf rule; fix the one hit, then vendor.

no-chained-type-assertions.reason: Same rule as Dillon's, bundled by @mpsuesser/oxlint-plugin-effect.

no-conditional-spread.reason: Foldkit views build child lists with `...(cond ? [x] : [])`; Dillon's narrower empty-object version is on.

no-manual-tag-comparison.reason: Best of the rest: catches `x._tag === "..."` that effect/avoid-direct-tag-checks misses. Clean the 32 non-test hits first.

no-manual-tagged-type.reason: Flags `Extract<Union, { _tag: "X" }>` narrowing, not just hand-declared tags.

sandro.author: Sandro Maglione
sandro.reachesUs: Not yet; a reference repo meant to be copied from. Several of our rules share his ideas.
notes: Targets React, XState, Next.js and Tailwind apps; most UI rules do not apply to Foldkit.

no-ambient-nondeterminism.reason: Ours only fire inside Effects or core; Sandro's 5 hits are outside them.

no-api-backend-imports.reason: Fallow zones in .fallowrc.jsonc own import boundaries.

no-api-repository-imports.reason: Fallow zones in .fallowrc.jsonc own import boundaries.

no-comments.reason: AGENTS.md wants rationale comments and named lint suppressions; Kyle dropped his copy too.

no-css-modules.reason: We have no CSS Modules; nothing to guard.

no-direct-xstate-create-machine.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

no-direct-xstate-use-selector.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

no-disable-validation.reason: No hits; protects Schema decoding at the boundary.

no-effect-asvoid.reason: Taste; Effect.asVoid is idiomatic. Warn-level upstream.

no-multiple-function-params.reason: Conflicts with Effect's data-last and pipeable APIs; 226 hits.

no-multiple-xstate-hooks.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

no-nested-effect-array-methods.reason: 4 hits; nested Effect Array calls lose inference.

no-react-component-inner-functions.reason: We have no React; the UI is Foldkit.

no-react-non-component-function-exports.reason: We have no React; the UI is Foldkit.

no-react-state-hooks.reason: We have no React; the UI is Foldkit.

no-reexport-only-modules.reason: 6 hits; check against package export maps first.

no-single-use-private-functions.reason: Conflicts with naming steps for readability in deep modules.

no-single-use-xstate-actions.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

no-single-use-xstate-guards.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

no-static-effect-service-forwarders.reason: No hits; matches 'declare a port where consumed'.

no-switch.reason: Backend only; the 1 hit is UI.

no-typeof-object.reason: Backend only; the 1 hit is UI.

no-xstate-derived-boolean-context.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.

prefer-effect-match.reason: Same idea as dillon/prefer-effect-match; pick one copy.

prefer-typed-schema-apis.reason: Needs Sandro's own Compiler API engine beside tsgo; revisit if tsgo gains it.

require-cn-for-classname-composition.reason: Targets JSX className; Foldkit views already use cn.

require-context-service-in-services.reason: Assumes a services/ folder layout we do not use.

require-xstate-event-satisfies.reason: We have no XState; state machines use effect-machine.
